exposure: Cervical length measured at 14-24 weeks of gestation
cohort: 173 mothers from the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology of Burdwan Medical College and Hospital, India, who met inclusion/exclusion criteria.
finding: The study found that 16.2% of the participants experienced preterm delivery, with the majority of these mothers being 20-30 years old, nulliparous, primigravid, and of normal weight.
gest_age: Cervical length was measured at 14-24 weeks of gestation, and outcomes were categorized as preterm or term delivery.
